name: Raghav Productivity Enhancers Ltd (RPEL)
tagline: Debt-free, high-ROCE (~30%) niche ramming-mass/quartz-powder leader whose growth has genuinely re-accelerated (FY26 PAT +48.2% YoY, Q1 FY27 PAT +67.6% YoY) on a two-pronged capacity expansion - but the stock has re-rated to ~127x P/E / 32x P/B, a level that already prices in years of hyper-growth from an unproven new JV; an elongated ~255-day working-capital cycle and rising related-party transactions keep thesis_fit at 'neither' despite the operational improvement.
business_overview: Raghav Productivity Enhancers (formerly Raghav Ramming Mass Ltd, renamed Nov 2017) manufactures silica ramming mass and other quartz-based refractory products used to line induction furnaces, serving recycled-steel, foundry and incineration industries from its Jaipur base, with group manufacturing capacity of ~534,000 MTPA (pre-JV) sold across 26 Indian states and 40+ export countries. Note: state.json name 'Raghav Productivity Solutions' matches this listed entity with high confidence - 'Raghav Productivity Solutions Private Limited' became RPEL's own subsidiary effective 1 April 2025 (and paid RPEL a Rs 4.56cr dividend in Q1 FY27), so any market reference to 'Raghav Productivity Solutions' as an investable name resolves to the listed parent, RPEL. On 8-Sep-2026 RPEL announced a strategic JV with TRL Krosaki Refractories to build a 350,000 MTPA silica ramming-mass plant in Odisha (~Rs 100cr initial investment) - its first multi-location/JV move, expanding into East India. Originally seeded via untrusted X triage (@jeevanpatwa, bullish, very-high conviction, 2026-09-13).

fundamentals_narrative: Quality metrics remain strong - ROCE ~30%, ROE ~24%, debt-free, and growth has genuinely re-accelerated: FY26 revenue +28.8%/PAT +48.2% YoY, and Q1 FY27 PAT +67.6% YoY, well past the prior pass's ~12% CAGR figure (which understated the current trajectory - growth was clearly picking up into FY26/27, not flat at ~12%). But the stock has also re-rated sharply: ~127x trailing P/E and ~32x P/B (screener.in, Sept 2026) is among the richest multiples for any Indian industrial-materials name, and now clearly prices in years of continued hyper-growth funded partly by a brand-new, unproven JV (TRL Krosaki, Odisha, ~Rs100cr, announced 8-Sep-2026). A ~255-day working-capital cycle (Mar 2026) and press-flagged rising related-party transactions are new caution flags this pass. Promoter holding is clean and stable (~62.9%, zero pledge, all 4 disclosed quarters Sep2025-Jun2026).
